g.text: Every call re-sends the whole conversation, so two agents that never agree bill 900,250 tokens for one room.
Believe transport cost is zero, and:
· marshaling burns CPU at both ends
· the bill arrives a month later
Each request costs the same; the bill is a straight line.
Fix: small payloads, compact formats, fewer calls;
cache what repeats; a quota per client.
(1) no token budget, only 40 agent turns
(2) the orchestrator asks for something cheaper
(3) every call carries the whole conversation
Fix: a token budget for the run, checked before every
model call; the chat ends after round 3, at 42,600 tokens.
